Requirement description: The BMS shall monitor individual cell voltages across all series-connected cells within the battery pack.
The BMS shall monitor battery module and coolant temperatures across defined thermal zones.
The BMS shall calculate the battery State of Charge (SoC) during active and standby states.
The BMS shall calculate the battery State of Health (SoH) and persist updated values to non-volatile memory.
The BMS shall control high-voltage (HV) main and pre-charge contactors to safely connect and isolate the pack.
The BMS shall detect cell overvoltage conditions and trigger a fault reaction within the defined fault-tolerant time interval.
The BMS shall calculate and provide dynamic maximum charging current limits to the On-Board Charger (OBC) and VCU.
The BMS shall communicate battery status
Parent requirement: and active fault bitmasks to the Vehicle Control Unit (VCU).

Requirement description: The BMS shall measure bidirectional pack current at a minimum 10 ms acquisition rate.
The BMS shall execute a controlled DC-link pre-charge sequence before closing the main positive contactor.
The BMS shall verify High-Voltage Interlock Loop (HVIL) continuity and insulation resistance prior to HV bus energization.
The BMS shall equalize cell voltages through controlled cell balancing during charging and standby modes.
The BMS shall calculate dynamic maximum discharge current limits based on SoC
The BMS shall detect cell undervoltage conditions and derate or isolate discharge current to prevent deep discharge.
The BMS shall detect battery overtemperature conditions
Parent requirement: and isolate HV on critical thresholds.

Requirement description: The BMS shall debounce raw fault flags
The BMS shall detect loss of CAN communication with the VCU and transition to a safe isolated state
The BMS shall detect welded or stuck HV contactors via physical feedback and inhibit further HV activation.
The BMS shall coordinate startup self-tests
The BMS shall isolate the HV battery pack within 20 ms upon receiving a critical emergency open request.
